annotations.title: Audit Supply Chain Risk (NIST 800-161 C-SCRM, NDAA 889, FASCSA, TAA, BAA) & Generate SBOM Attestation

description: Audit hardware Bills of Materials (BOMs), sub-tier suppliers, and software components (SBOM) against NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM), FAR 52.204-25 (NDAA Section 889 Part A/B prohibition on Huawei, ZTE, Hytera, Hikvision, Dahua and their affiliates), FAR 52.204-30 (FASCSA exclusion orders), the Buy American Act (FAR Part 25 domestic content), and the Trade Agreements Act (FAR 52.225-5 designated countries), returning JSON with a Supply Chain Risk Score (0-100), an overall SCRM verdict, per-line NDAA 889 and TAA determinations, a BAA domestic-content percentage, NIST 800-161 SR-family control gaps, an NTIA minimum-elements SBOM and CISA Secure Software Self-Attestation readiness review, paste-ready C-SCRM Plan sections, a SCRM POA&M remediation roadmap, and a proposal-ready SCRM narrative. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive compliance auditor (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; nothing is stored, filed, or submitted to SAM.gov, and FASCSA results must still be verified in SAM.gov; `solicitation_or_contract_context` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, `bom_line_items` accepts 1 to 200 lines, and `software_components` accepts up to 500 SBOM components). Use this tool when vetting a BOM, reseller quote, or SBOM for NDAA 889 / FASCSA / TAA / BAA award eligibility or drafting a C-SCRM Plan and SBOM attestation; use `audit_section_508_vpat` instead for Section 508 / WCAG 2.2 accessibility and VPAT conformance, `scan_far_dfars_clauses` for general Section I FAR/DFARS clause flow-down risk scanning, `answer_security_questionnaire` for SOC 2 / FedRAMP / NIST 800-171 questionnaires, or `generate_ato_rmf_package` for NIST 800-53 SSP / RMF / cATO authorization packages.

additional_supplier_notes.description: Optional sub-tier supplier attestations, SAM.gov FAR 52.204-24/26 representations, ownership/affiliation notes, or existing C-SCRM program documentation (0 to 20,000 characters).

applicable_contract_clauses.description: Supply chain clauses and standards in the solicitation, e.g. 'FAR 52.204-25', 'FAR 52.204-30', 'FAR 52.225-5', 'DFARS 252.225-7001', 'DFARS 252.204-7012', 'DFARS 252.246-7008', 'NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1', 'OMB M-22-18' (0 to 40 entries).

items.description: One clause or standard citation, e.g. 'FAR 52.204-25'.

bom_line_items.description: Hardware / COTS Bill of Materials line items to screen (1 to 200 lines).

country_of_origin.description: Country of origin or substantial transformation (ISO 3166 alpha-2 code or country name, e.g. 'US', 'Mexico', 'China').

description.description: Short item description, e.g. '4MP IP Dome Camera'.

domestic_component_cost_pct.description: Optional known US-domestic component cost percentage (0-100) for this line; null if unknown.

item_category.description: Item category used to route NDAA 889, FASCSA, TAA, BAA (COTS IT exception), and counterfeit-parts logic.

line_item_id.description: Unique BOM / CLIN / quote line identifier, e.g. 'BOM-001' or 'CLIN 0001'.

manufacturer.description: OEM brand / legal entity, screened against NDAA 889 covered entities and known affiliates or white-label OEMs.

part_number.description: Manufacturer part number (MPN), SKU, or NSN, e.g. 'C9300-48P-E'.

quantity.description: Quantity of units on this line.

supplier_name.description: Reseller, distributor, or sub-tier supplier furnishing the item (blank if bought direct from the OEM).

supplier_tier.description: Supply chain tier of the furnishing supplier relative to the prime offeror.

unit_cost_usd.description: Unit price in USD, used for TAA thresholds and BAA domestic-content weighting.

contracting_agency.description: Contracting agency or SLED buyer, e.g. 'U.S. Army PEO C3T', 'GSA FAS', or 'Arizona ADOA-ASET' (2 to 300 characters).

offeror_name.description: Legal name of the prime offeror / reseller submitting the BOM and supply chain representations (2 to 300 characters).

sbom_format.description: Format of the offeror's SBOM deliverable: 'CycloneDX_1_6' (default), 'SPDX_2_3', 'SPDX_3_0', 'Proprietary_Or_Spreadsheet', or 'None_Available'.

software_components.description: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) components for NTIA minimum-elements and CISA secure software attestation review (0 to 500 components).

known_vulnerabilities.description: Known CVE / GHSA identifiers or CISA KEV entries affecting this version (0 to 50).

supplier.description: Component supplier / author organization (NTIA 'Supplier Name' element).

solicitation_or_contract_context.description: Solicitation / contract scope, Section H/I supply chain clauses, delivery location, end-use, and any agency C-SCRM, NDAA 889, TAA, BAA, or SBOM requirements (20 to 45,000 characters).

target_compliance_regime.description: Target supply chain regulatory regime: 'Auto_Detect_From_Clauses' (default), 'Federal_DoD_Full_C_SCRM_NDAA_889_TAA_BAA', 'Federal_Civilian_FASCSA_And_CISA_Secure_Software', or 'State_SLED_Prohibited_Vendor_And_Domestic_Preference'.

name: audit_supply_chain_scrm

baa_domestic_content.description: Buy American Act domestic content percentage, applicable threshold, and status.

c_scrm_plan_sections.description: Paste-ready C-SCRM Plan sections aligned to NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1.

executive_scrm_summary.description: Executive supply chain risk summary for the Contracting Officer.

fascsa_exclusion_check.description: FAR 52.204-30 FASCSA exclusion order screening status and SAM.gov sources to verify.

ndaa_889_findings.description: Per-line FAR 52.204-25 Section 889 Part A/B prohibited-vendor findings.

nist_800_161_control_gaps.description: NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1 SR-family control gaps with severity and implementation guidance.

ready_to_submit_scrm_narrative.description: Paste-ready proposal SCRM volume narrative with NDAA 889 / FASCSA representations, TAA/BAA certification, and SBOM attestation.

sbom_attestation.description: NTIA minimum-elements SBOM review and CISA Secure Software Self-Attestation readiness.

supply_chain_risk_score.description: Supply chain risk score from 0 (no material risk) to 100 (prohibited / award-blocking).

taa_compliance_by_line.description: Per-line Trade Agreements Act designated-country determinations.

title: Audit Supply Chain Risk (NIST 800-161 C-SCRM, NDAA 889, FASCSA, TAA, BAA) & Generate SBOM Attestation
